subject: Warmstart fallback coordination and exec ask
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dina Patel <dina.patel@novaplex.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Warmstart fallback coordination and exec ask

Team —

We started seeing elevated tail latency and a ~0.8% increase in 5xxs for Novaplex's gen-api starting around 08:45 PDT. Initial SLO alerts show p99 spikes from 420ms -> 1.8s and a few client retries. I've attached a perf dump (perf-dump-0411.tar.gz) and a short FlameGraph.

Options on the table:
- Immediate routing change: shift 30% of Novaplex traffic to v2-lite (model variant) for 10–15m while we triage.
- Short-term hotfix: kv-cache eviction policy tweak (kv-hotfix.diff) which SRE estimates as a ~3h turnaround including QA.
- Rollback to prior routing policy (risk: transient quality regressions for Novaplex users).

Asks:
- SRE (Soojin): can you confirm whether kv evictions are the dominant signal? ETA for a safe hotfix?
- Eng/Product (Karthik/Marissa): tradeoffs of v2-lite routing vs rollback; can we do a canary at 10%?
- CS (Grace): prepare a one-paragraph customer note if we need a short diversion or mitigation.

I'm proposing a quick decision call at 09:45 to lock in action. If we don't have consensus, I want SRE to proceed with the routing shift as safest stopgap.

Thanks,
Rafael

-- 
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dina Patel <dina.patel@novaplex.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warmstart fallback coordination and exec ask

Thanks for the heads up, Rafael. Quick triage notes:
- Signal: our heap and KV eviction counters started trending up at ~08:40; eviction rate up ~6x versus baseline for Novaplex tenant. I do see a correlation between eviction spikes and p99 increases in the logs.
- Root cause hypothesis: a small regression in the recent memory allocator kernel combined with a high prefix variety from Novaplex requests is causing more frequent KV churn.

Options (operational):
- Routing shift to v2-lite is low-risk and can be done in the control plane in ~5m. Quality delta: estimated 2–4% degradation on a small set of prompts (worth tradeoff to stabilize latency).
- kv-cache eviction policy change: we'd push kv-hotfix.diff to canary, run 30m of load, then promote; conservative ETA 2.5–3.5h (includes perf tests). Might require brief restarts for a subset of workers.
- Rollback: would restore previous allocator but requires a deploy rollback and a longer QA window (~4–5h) with potential regression on other tenants.

My recommendation: do immediate 30% routing shift to v2-lite for 10–15m, monitor p99 and error rate. If that stabilizes, continue working the kv-hotfix in parallel.

Action item for me: I'll push the routing rule to preview and post the rule JSON to the thread.

— Soojin
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dina Patel <dina.patel@novaplex.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warmstart fallback coordination and exec ask

On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 9:27 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> My recommendation: do immediate 30% routing shift to v2-lite for 10–15m, monitor p99 and error rate.

Agree with Soojin. A few product notes:
- v2-lite parity: the model answers fewer tokens and occasionally truncates very long completions. For typical Novaplex flows (chat + short generation) impact should be minimal, but we need to flag it to their engineering lead.
- Canary plan: prefer a phased canary (10% for 10m -> 30% for 10m) to reduce oscillation. If latency improves at 10% we can ramp.
- kv-hotfix: engineering reviewed kv-hotfix.diff; it is low-risk but requires a migration step for active worker state. Engineering estimate for a staged rollout (canary -> 50% -> 100%) is ~3 hours with a 30m monitoring window per stage.

Request to Eng: can you provide a quick checklist of the staged rollout steps and a single-point owner for the hotfix? I can triage QA resources.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Dina Patel <dina.patel@novaplex.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warmstart fallback coordination and exec ask

Thanks for the update. We started seeing retries from our users and elevated error logs around 08:50 — this matches what you reported. A couple of asks from our side: 
- ETA: can you confirm a firm timeline for a mitigation and a permanent fix? Our ops team is being asked for an incident timeline.
- Impact: how will routing to v2-lite affect our user experience? Any measurable metric we should surface to our product team?
- Credits: if this is tied to the service change, we will likely request a service credit for the impacted window.

Appreciate the quick coordination — we can join a 15m sync if helpful.

--
Dina Patel
Head of Platform Reliability, Novaplex
dina.patel@novaplex.com

Update and plan (decisions locked):
- Immediate action (09:20 PDT): control plane will apply a phased canary: 10% -> 30% traffic to v2-lite over 20m window. Soojin to initiate at 10:20 and monitor p99 and 5xxs.
- Parallel action: SRE + Eng will run kv-hotfix canary after immediate ramp. Owner: Soojin (SRE) + Priyanka (engineer on-call) — ETA to full rollout ~3h from canary start. Karthik will coordinate QA windows.
- Customer comms: Grace to draft a short status note for Novaplex summarizing what happened, what we changed, and next steps. Include estimated ETA for permanent fix and an offer to discuss credits.

Action items (owners):
- Soojin: post routing-rule JSON to thread and kick canary at 10:20 (control plane link: routing-rule-preview.json). Monitor and report p95/p99 every 5m.
- Priyanka (ENG): prepare kv-hotfix canary steps and test harness (attach kv-hotfix.diff).
- Karthik: QA sign-off and monitor metric rollups during staged rollout.
- Grace: customer note + draft to Dina by 11:00.
- Rafael: escalate to leadership if we hit >2% errors or if canary doesn't reduce p99.

Attachments: perf-dump-0411.tar.gz (full traces), kv-hotfix.diff (patch), routing-rule-preview.json (control-plane preview).

Links: JIRA NOV-4521, Confluence warmstart runbook, drive perf dump link above.

I'll post a short readout after the 10:40 check-in.

Thanks all,
Rafael
